chunks: And it is narrated: “That he walks from behind the Maqam.”

key_terms.الْمَقَامِ: the Maqam; the Station of Ibrahim in the sacred precinct
key_terms.خَلْفِ: behind; indicates the direction or position relative to something
key_terms.رُوِيَ: it is narrated; an impersonal transmission formula indicating a reported narration
key_terms.يَمْشِي: he walks; refers to the prescribed act of moving on foot

ai.seo_question: From which side should one walk in relation to the Maqam of Ibrahim?
ai.summary: This report indicates a legal practice concerning movement in relation to the Maqam of Ibrahim. It points to the prescribed manner of passing or walking from behind the Maqam within the rites being discussed.
